title: Recovery after new writes
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Roll back after new writes; choose compatible recovery rather than discarding committed state.
preconditions: JavaScript and standalone local HTML file access; no account or server
Fixed baseline L001 reserves 6 units; v2 L002 reserves 3 and L003 releases 1
All payload contracts and reader policies are predetermined teaching data, not a schema migration
Illustrative 10 ms read budget, fixed available read latency 7 ms, at most 12 decisions
syntheticInput: 4 allowlisted recovery plans, 4 observation choices and 4 learner predictions; no user-supplied records or operations
expectedAssertions: Compatible v1 rollback and explicit v2.1 forward recovery retain all 3 effects and read the correct signed total of 8
Baseline-only reader and old-snapshot restoration are rejected without discarding new writes
Missing or corrupted reads fail; unavailable read evidence remains unknown
Only a verified supported recovery changes the effective teaching destination
Learner verdict, recovery outcome and safe rejection remain distinct
Strict input, stale-token and phase guards are atomic; reset preserves history and denominators
Keyboard controls, focused errors, bounded output and enforced CSP work in the actual isolated browser
limits: Only fixed, memory-only synthetic writes, readers and recovery; no real data operations
One decision per rehearsal and at most 12 decisions including rejections
Reset restores the baseline controls but retains every earlier decision; deliberate reload clears memory
No native Azure, actual write/compatibility/rollback/recovery certification, source-parent completion, production Node.js 24 or five-nines claim
